create_chat.description: Start a chat with a person, by email address - they do not have to be a Pushbullet user. Nothing is sent to them: this only files them on the account, ready for 'Send note' with Send to set to an email address.

muted.description: If true, notifications from this chat are not shown

iden.description: If this is a user, the iden of that user

image_url.description: Image to display for the person

create_device.description: Create a device on the account. No hardware is involved - a device is just a record - so this is how a workflow gives itself somewhere to push that is not everybody's phone. It shows up in the Pushbullet apps like any other device.
